description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git archive' command with various options and corner cases. It includes setup functions, prerequisites checks, and multiple test cases covering different archive formats and edge cases such as empty trees, long paths, and large files.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory and ensures it's cleaned up after tests.

methods.name: check_dir
methods.description: Verifies that the directory contains exactly the specified set of paths.

methods.name: build_tree
methods.description: Constructs a tree object with long paths for testing.
